meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: Argentina v Serbia and Montenegro | Group C | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, Brazil v France | Quarter-finals | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, All Goals | FIFA Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™, FACTS: Italy v France | Germany 2006, Brazil v Colombia | Quarter-finals | 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
